top_violation_types.title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2021 data from February 23, 2022, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2021 by February 22, 2022, as required.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §746.5101(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation does not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Child-Care Center Must be Equipped with a Working Carbon Monoxide (CO) Detection System (26 TAC §746.5531)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a carbon monoxide detector.

top_violation_types.title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment - Hand-washing Sink (26 TAC §746.2405(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: No handwashing sinks were observed in rooms where diaper change will be happening.

top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two infants did not have current infant feeding schedules.

top_violation_types.title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone (26 TAC §745.621(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A caregiver, with direct access to children, was present without a background check eligibility.  The caregiver was sent home during the inspection.
